- All root/stem diseases (Phytophthora, Diaporthe, Rhizoctonia, etc.) — not matching leaf lesion pattern

The angular, vein-delimited edges and dark brown coloration of the large necrotic area are most consistent with **Bacterial_Blight** where multiple angular lesions have coalesced. The progression from water-soaked angular spots to large coalesced dark brown necrosis is characteristic.
